arms.g1_cos_sel: Q1 score (teacher cosine s, alpha_score = softmax(16 s)) + selective fallback
arms.g2_vcs_sel: Q2 score (VCS relation head g fitted from scratch, alpha_score = softmax(2 g)) + selective fallback
arms.r1_res_vcs_sel: cosine-anchored residual VCS: g = a s + b + r_phi, residual fitted with the original J(T), T = tanh(g); alpha_score = softmax((16/a) g) + selective fallback
arms.r2_res_bce_sel: same structure, residual fitted with balanced BCE (logit 2g) + selective fallback

references_reused_not_rerun.identity_condition: same prefix, data, noise lock, seed, 40-epoch host; Q1/Q2 code paths byte-identical in code_r28 (r27q_pool.py, r27q_config.py unchanged; refiner alpha-only and native paths checked bitwise vs code_q)

main_comparisons: G1-Q1 and G2-Q2 (effect of the selective fallback)
R1-A1 and every arm vs C-native

scores.teacher_coordinates: R27-Q convention (r27q_pool.teacher_scores): teacher = other peer eval/no-grad, unaugmented inputs; query captions centered by the noisy batch caption mean, candidates by the noisy batch observed-image mean; l2norm
scores.g1: s = q.y; logits 16 s (R27-Q Q1, BETA_COS = 16)
scores.g2: R27-Q Q2 head: PairHead [q*y, |q-y|, q.y] -> 256 -> 1 (525057 params), original VCS J, T = tanh(g), P = stage high-confidence observed pairs, Q = empirical product of the same P incl. the diagonal, 200 Adam steps lr 1e-3 batch 128, init under stage_seed+17; logits 2 g (BETA_HEAD = 2). Produced by the very calls of r27q_pool.begin_stage (bitwise the Q2 head at the same state)
scores.anchor: per peer stage, on the stage fit P (teacher coordinates, the same pairs that fit the residual) and the FULL empirical product of its two marginals incl. the diagonal (all n_fit x n_fit caption/image pairs): minimize the balanced logistic loss E_P softplus(-2 g0) + E_Q softplus(2 g0) over (a, b) (Platt-type scalar calibration of 0.5 log(p/q), convex; the diagonal is in both P and Q so the optimum is finite); damped Newton with Armijo backtracking, float64 reductions. a, b are then frozen and only the residual is fitted. Shared by R1 and R2 (same function of the same stage data).
scores.residual: r_phi = the Q2 PairHead (same inputs/params/init seed) with the last layer zero-initialised (r == 0 at fit start); fitted for STEPS=200 with Adam lr 1e-3 batch 128 and the same index sequence as the Q2 head; R1: maximize J(T), T = tanh(a s + b + r); R2: minimize E_P softplus(-2g) + E_Q softplus(2g); a, b frozen during the fit
scores.r_readout: alpha_score = softmax((16/a) * (a s + b + r)), computed as softmax(16 s + (16/a) r) (the constant 16 b / a cancels); r = 0 -> softmax(16 s) elementwise (the Q1 alpha, bitwise in code)
scores.not_done: g0 is NOT written as 8 s; beta = 16/a only restores the task readout; no temperature, K, solver, angle, dropout sweeps

support_u.function: u = sigmoid(c + w . [best_cos, ab_overlap, ab_top1_agree]); one shared low-capacity logistic for all four arms (same function / rule / budget), refitted at every peer stage on the frozen teacher with the stage seed

features.best_cos: max over the K candidates of the teacher cosine q.y (R27-Q teacher coordinates; the Q1 score)
features.ab_overlap: |A5 & B5| / 5: overlap of the two C_mix routes' unique top-5 image-ID lists (A: query . teacher text bank -> partner observed image IDs; B: query . teacher image bank)
features.ab_top1_agree: 1[A route top-1 ID == B route top-1 ID]

support_u.calibration: pool = stage P rows (teacher high-confidence labeled rows, observed pairing) NOT used by the head/residual fit or held-out sets; observed-image IDs of the pool shuffled (stage generator) and split in half -> fit / report groups (no observed image in both); rows of each group shuffled, first N_CAL_FIT / N_CAL_REP taken (rounded down to 128). Each row: query = its caption in teacher coordinates (unaugmented, centered by its 128-row chunk mean); candidates = the ACTUAL C_mix rule (r27cs_sources.unique_topk + mix_3a_2b on the teacher queue) with the query's own queue record(s) (slot caption ID == query caption ID) excluded from BOTH routes (direct-copy channel; same for all arms); rows short of 5 unique IDs dropped. weak label = 1[observed image ID in the 5 candidates]; the observed item is never inserted. Logistic regression on U_FEATURES + intercept, ridge on the weights only, Newton/IRLS float64 to convergence.
support_u.report: calibration-fit and separate report split (disjoint observed images): weak-label coverage, u mean with / without the observed pair, frac u >= .5 with / without, Brier, log-loss, ECE (10 bins), AUC; logged per stage (rstage_calfit_* / rstage_calrep_*)
support_u.nature: an application calibration on training-visible observed supervision, not a probability given by the CS-QMI theorem; the injected-noise pairing is used only by the evaluator (r28_fit_eval.py, gate evaluator-only counts), never to choose thresholds
support_u.own_record_exclusion: queue slots whose caption ID equals the query caption ID are removed from both routes during calibration (direct copy channel); identical for all arms. Application candidates are the unchanged production C_mix.

pre_registered_fallbacks.anchor: R1/R2 only: the residual is not fitted and r = 0 for the whole stage, so alpha_score = softmax(16 s) (exactly the G1 score readout); counted in rstage_aff_fallback. Same rule for both arms. Trigger: Newton not converged, non-finite, or a < A_MIN = 1.0.
pre_registered_fallbacks.support: intercept-only logistic: u = the calibration-fit weak-label rate (constant for the stage; 0 or 1 if one class is empty); used when the calibration-fit split has < MIN_CLASS rows of a class, or the Newton fit is non-finite / not converged. Counted in rstage_u_fallback. Same rule for all arms.

stage_schedule.when: start of every peer stage (model A with teacher B, then model B with teacher A), each epoch
stage_schedule.seed: SEED_BASE*seed + 2*epoch + peer (SEED_BASE 7919, = R27-Q), identical across arms; calibrator generator stage_seed + 31
stage_schedule.rng: torch.random.fork_rng (global CPU/CUDA RNG restored); numpy/python RNG untouched

hard_candidate_log: each held-out P caption (the head held-out set): its observed image + the 4 other distinct observed images of the held-out pool with the highest teacher cosine (= the R27-Q trial calibration set); logged per stage: observed top-1 / mean rank / NLL under the arm score readout

config.AFF_FALLBACK: R1/R2 only: the residual is not fitted and r = 0 for the whole stage, so alpha_score = softmax(16 s) (exactly the G1 score readout); counted in rstage_aff_fallback. Same rule for both arms.
config.AFF_RULE: per peer stage, on the stage fit P (teacher coordinates, the same pairs that fit the residual) and the FULL empirical product of its two marginals incl. the diagonal (all n_fit x n_fit caption/image pairs): minimize the balanced logistic loss E_P softplus(-2 g0) + E_Q softplus(2 g0) over (a, b) (Platt-type scalar calibration of 0.5 log(p/q), convex; the diagonal is in both P and Q so the optimum is finite); damped Newton with Armijo backtracking, float64 reductions. a, b are then frozen and only the residual is fitted.

Each row: query = its caption in teacher coordinates (unaugmented, centered by its 128-row chunk mean); candidates = the ACTUAL C_mix rule (r27cs_sources.unique_topk + mix_3a_2b on the teacher queue) with the query's own queue record(s) (slot caption ID == query caption ID) excluded from BOTH routes (direct-copy channel; same for all arms); rows short of 5 unique IDs dropped. weak label = 1[observed image ID in the 5 candidates]; the observed item is never inserted. Logistic regression on U_FEATURES + intercept, ridge on the weights only, Newton/IRLS float64 to convergence.
config.HARD_RULE: each held-out P caption (the head held-out set): its observed image + the 4 other distinct observed images of the held-out pool with the highest teacher cosine (= the R27-Q trial calibration set); logged per stage: observed top-1 / mean rank / NLL under the arm score readout
config.RESIDUAL_INIT: PairHead default init under torch.manual_seed(stage_seed+17) (= the Q2 head init), then the LAST layer (l2 weight and bias) set to zero -> r_phi == 0 at fit start
config.U_FALLBACK: intercept-only logistic: u = the calibration-fit weak-label rate (constant for the stage; 0 or 1 if one class is empty); used when the calibration-fit split has < MIN_CLASS rows of a class, or the Newton fit is non-finite / not converged. Counted in rstage_u_fallback. Same rule for all arms.
